description: Play Sharp X68000 MDX music on CardputerZero.

store.summary: Play Sharp X68000 MDX music with live FM and PCM meters.
store.description: Play MDX music from your local library, with PDX sample support, a note spectrum, and individual FM and PCM meters. Browse folders, save favorites, and choose repeat or continuous playback. Auto audio mode mixes both channels for the built-in speaker and switches to stereo when headphones are connected. Press M to select Auto, Mono, or Stereo. Copy your MDX files and any matching PDX banks to Music/MDX Library in your home folder.
